items.title: Pinoy students improved in PISA 2025
items.description: Filipino students’ scores in reading, mathematics and science have improved significantly in the 2025 Program for International Student Assessment , Education Secretary Sonny Angara said yesterday.

items.description: he recently released P1 billion will further expand Project Nationwide Operational Assessment of Hazards, focusing on strengthening flood management, hazard monitoring and disaster risk reduction systems as the country confronts the effects of climate change.

items.title: Recantations can aid Martin, say House allies
items.description: Recantations of several witnesses in the flood control controversy could help weaken the plunder case against Leyte Rep. Martin Romualdez, two of his allies said yesterday.

items.title: Defense, prosecution can grill Sara’s security officers
items.description: In a reversal of his previous ruling, Senate impeachment court presiding officer Francis Escudero said he will now allow both the defense and the prosecution to direct and cross-examine Vice President Sara Duterte’s security officers, Colonels Dennis Nolasco and Raymund Dante Lachica, in case they are summoned to the witness stand.

items.title: VP will attend arraignment on Friday – Poa
items.description: Vice President Sara Duterte will be physically present at the Quezon City Regional Trial Court on Friday in connection with the three counts of grave threats filed by the Department of Justice against her.

items.title: All NLEX San Simon lanes reopen
items.description: The North Luzon Expressway is now fully open to vehicular traffic with the completion by the Department of Public Works and Highways of initial structural works to prevent monsoon-induced heavy flooding, the latest of which lasted for days and left traffic at a standstill, especially along the San Simon and Tulaoc Bridge sections.

items.title: Chinese fighter jets intercept Philippine patrol aircraft
items.description: In yet another display of “coercive and aggressive actions,” Chinese fighter jets intercepted a Philippine aircraft patrolling Panatag (Scarborough) Shoal or Bajo de Masinloc last week, the Armed Forces of the Philippines  confirmed yesterday.

items.title: NBI seeks lookout bulletin vs Leviste, Paras, 5 others
items.description: The National Bureau of Investigation  is seeking an immigration lookout bulletin order against Batangas Rep. Leandro Leviste and six others linked to an alleged honey trap planned against Executive Secretary Ralph Recto.

items.title: Remullas flying  to France for Co
items.description: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin Remulla and his brother Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla are planning to fly separately to France in pursuit of those facing criminal cases in the Philippines.
